single_run_closed_form.description: A four-observation hand-calculable path used as an implementation-independent regression anchor.

provenance.annualization: Arithmetic mean multiplied by four; sample volatility multiplied by sqrt(4).
provenance.path: Wealth path is 1.1, 0.88, 0.924, 1.2012; the peak-to-trough loss is exactly 20%.
provenance.psr: Normal CDF applied to the higher-moment-adjusted period-Sharpe statistic.
provenance.statistics: Sample variance, adjusted Fisher-Pearson skewness, and unbiased excess kurtosis closed forms.
